packageRules.description: Go toolchain, part 1: the gomod manager leaves the `go` directive alone by default, so Renovate bumped only the Dockerfile's golang image (#643) and TestDockerfileGoMatchesGoMod rightly failed that PR. That is how the stdlib fix for GO-2026-6809 (Go 1.27.3) sat unmerged while `vuln` was red on every branch. `bump` makes Renovate move the go directive as well.

Go toolchain, part 2: ship the go.mod `go` directive and the Dockerfile `golang:<patch>-alpine` stage in ONE PR. TestDockerfileGoMatchesGoMod requires them equal, and CI resolves every Go job from go.mod, so either half alone is red by construction.

Block PostgreSQL major upgrades: a new major (e.g. 18 -> 19) makes the existing /var/lib/postgresql data directory incompatible with no pg_upgrade path in these compose/helm deployments, so the db container crashloops. Majors require a deliberate manual migration plan.
CloudNativePG instance image: follow the dated rebuilds (`18.6-202610260820-system-trixie`) and 18.x minors. Instances roll by switchover; 7-day release age.
Block PostgreSQL majors for the CNPG instance image too: 18 -> 19 needs a dump/restore or pg_upgrade, not an image bump.

customManagers.description: CloudNativePG instance image in the Helm chart: postgresql.imageName is not an image:/repository+tag pair, so the helm-values manager cannot see it. Captures the @sha256 digest so tag and digest move together.
